startNote: Elected District 2 commissioner at the March 14, 2006 municipal election (Resolution 2006-27, adopted Mar 22, 2006, declares him elected). His first meeting is Mar 22, 2006 (roll call; not on the Mar 1, 2006 roll). No oath record is in the online archive.
endNote: Last meeting Oct 17, 2012 (the minutes call it his final meeting as a commissioner; proclamation honoring his service). He is not on the Nov 7, 2012 roll, and Resolution 2012-110 (Dec 5, 2012) calls a special election for District II "by virtue of the resignations of Commissioner Jared Moskowitz and Commissioner John Willis". The effective date of his resign-to-run letter is not in the online records; 2012-11-06 is the start of his Florida House term (Florida House record), so the city records confirm only that he left between Oct 17 and Nov 7, 2012.

viceMayor.note: Nominated and elected Vice Mayor 4-1 at the Nov 17, 2006 special meeting (McGilvray no); at the Nov 5, 2008 meeting he moved that Weissman serve as the next Vice Mayor (passed unanimously).
